cases.prompt: Prospect brief: is Hicks Nurseries, the family-owned garden center and nursery in Westbury, NY (on Long Island, in business since the 1850s, website hicksnurseries.com), a good brokerage prospect? I'm a business broker and want to know whether to approach the owners. Use public information only and check the web.
assertions: [O] states no revenue/EBITDA figure as fact; any size is a labeled band with assumptions and "not a valuation"
[O] each of the two 0–100 scores cites specific signals
[O] every Fact carries a source URL and date
[O] recommendation is exactly one of pursue-brokering / pursue-consulting / pass / need more

cases.prompt: Prospect brief on Zephyrine Brookhaven Millwork LLC in Patchogue, NY. Is it a good brokerage prospect? I can't find a website for them.
assertions: [O] recommendation is "need more" (or equivalent) — no high score on thin evidence
[O] does not fabricate officers, formation date or financials
